description: Resolve a gene by symbol + species (or by stable ID) to its Ensembl ID, genomic location (chr:start-end:strand), biotype, description, and transcript list. Entry point for most workflows — the stable ID and coordinates returned here are inputs to other tools. Accepts both symbol lookup (BRCA2 + homo_sapiens) and direct ID lookup (ENSG00000139618). A symbol that is not a current gene name is matched against synonyms and former symbols (HER2 → ERBB2), reported as matchedAlias; when it maps to several genes the result is ambiguous, listing the candidates to retry by id. Supports batch lookup of up to 20 IDs or symbols in one call via the ids or symbols field. Provide exactly one of symbol, id, ids, or symbols. For symbol lookups species defaults to homo_sapiens (override for other organisms); for ID lookups species is not needed. Use ensembl_list_species with nameContains (a genus or common name) to find valid species names.

expand_transcripts.description: When true, include the full transcript list in the response. Each transcript has its ID, biotype, canonical flag, and coordinates. Default is false to keep responses compact.

id.description: Ensembl stable gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000139618). A version suffix on an ENS… ID (ENSG00000139618.19) is dropped before the lookup, which returns the current version. Species is not required for ID lookup.

ids.description: Batch lookup: up to 20 Ensembl stable IDs (ENSG…, ENST…). A version suffix on an ENS… ID is dropped before the lookup. Returns a succeeded/failed split; each item carries its query — the ID as submitted, version included — and each failed item a reason and recovery. Provide exactly one of symbol, id, ids, or symbols.

items.description: An Ensembl stable gene or transcript ID to resolve in this batch.

species.description: Species in Ensembl internal format: lowercase scientific name with underscores (e.g. homo_sapiens, mus_musculus, danio_rerio). Optional for symbol lookups — defaults to homo_sapiens; set it for other organisms. Use ensembl_list_species with nameContains (a genus or common name) to find valid values.

symbol.description: Gene symbol to look up (e.g. BRCA2, TP53, EGFR). Species defaults to homo_sapiens; set species for other organisms. Case-insensitive in most species. A synonym or former symbol (HER2, TB1) resolves too; one shared by several genes returns ambiguous with the candidates instead of gene.

symbols.description: Batch lookup: up to 20 gene symbols. Species defaults to homo_sapiens; set species for other organisms. Returns a succeeded/failed split; each item carries its submitted query. Synonyms and former symbols resolve with matchedAlias; one shared by several genes fails with reason ambiguous and its candidates. Provide exactly one of symbol, id, ids, or symbols.
